en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Al Husayn, and Ali Bin Muhammad, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ali Bin Mahziyar who said,

‘I wrote to him<sup>asws</sup>, ‘O my Master<sup>asws</sup>! A man is handed over some wealth to a man to perform Hajj with. Would there be the Khums (fifth) upon him in that wealth when it comes to him, or would it be upon what is excess after the performance of the Hajj?’
So he<sup>asws</sup> wrote: ‘There isn’t the Khums upon it’.
